_comment: Hand-reviewed corrections to the German exercise catalog, applied to the
The German names live only in the DB — there is no seed file — so 1076
names were unversioned and could never be reviewed in a diff. That is why
the defects below survived. This file records every correction so it is at
least reviewable and re-appliable if the catalog is ever rebuilt.
Keys are exercises.id. Verified with server/services/translationAudit.ts:

_wrongEquipment._why: These named the WRONG implement — an athlete following them picks up dumbbells for a barbell lift.

_ambiguousHantel._why: German uses 'Hantel' for both Kurzhantel and Langhantel, so on its own it carries no information in a lifting app. Bench and position added back where the English carried them.

_why: 244 names were identical to their English source. Most of those are CORRECT:
and the like are the terms actually used in German gyms — translating them
would make the catalog worse, not better.
Only translated where German has a normal everyday word a German speaker
would expect to see. The remaining ~220 are deliberately left in English.
